name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: 433 Russian drones overnight into 1 Nov; hundreds of thousands without power
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 433 drones overnight into 1 Nov, 371 of which were downed, and strikes on energy facilities in four regions left hundreds of thousands of households without power (Reuters). Ukraine said it struck a missile-related plant in Rostov region; Russia said it intercepted 235 Ukrainian drones. Front lines changed little.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Energy and grain markets remain sensitive to the war.
rubric_hit: Full-scale war with mass strikes on infrastructure = Alert
